verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
GGWE Musumba-omulungi
Ggwe-okuuma endiga zo;
Tewali-ekiriyinza
Kuzikusikulako.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
-Omulokozi wawaayo
-Obulamu bwo ku lwaffe;
Mu ngalo zo mulimu
-Enkovu z'emisumaali.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naakutenderezanga
Nga mpulira by'omggamba;
Ndyoke nfaanane ng'abo
B'oli nabo mu ggulu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ayi-Musumba-omulungi
Beeranga kumpi nange,
Njige eddoboozi lyo,
Nkwatenga ekkubo lyo.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Naakugobereranga
Buli wonna w'oyita;
Olintuusa mu ggulu
Mu maaso ga Kitaffe.
